verdict.rationale: Cline's core interaction model is natural-language chat/commands—both in-editor (docs-1) and via CLI/headless mode with NL task examples like 'fix the layout issue shown in @./screenshot.png' (docs-18, docs-3/4)—and community testimony corroborates it operating effectively from plain-language plans ('I can plan with it for 10-15 minutes, set it loose... its diff is almost always completely on the money', cline-comm-3; 'most effective agentic coding tool', cline-comm-1). Missing for 10: independent benchmarking of NL command accuracy/robustness across varied phrasing beyond anecdotal HN comments.
